name: West Lytelthorpe Outpost
title: West Lytelthorpe Outpost
summary: A starter outpost destroyed by Martine in The First Strike (Beltslora, Tromylda the Shopkeeper; fountain, Life Stone, vat, well). In the kit: the outpost sits on a terrace (z 44-46) above a western ledge: a two-storey shop, a hut with a rabbit hutch, the Life Stone, a small fountain in a fern bed, a red-blossomed apple orchard and dead-tree props, and the 28 m ruined Empyrean monument tower (top z 73.9) at the terrace's west edge.
